svg.title: How a request of the app to Paperless reaches the local network
svg.desc: The test of the connection takes the switch from the form, a search takes the stored one. With the switch, the request passes allow_local_address and follows no redirect, so it reaches only the Paperless URL of the settings. Without it, Nextcloud checks the address: a public one is reached as before, with redirects that Nextcloud checks as well, and an address of the local network is refused before any request leaves Nextcloud, unless allow_local_remote_servers in config.php allows it to every app. A refused save names the switch.
